provenance.captureMethod: Captured by directly reading the existing completed v5 package before v6 delivery. PNG bytes and decoded RGBA hashes are actual source evidence; no values inferred from v6.

globalContracts.cellArtAlpha: Every pixel of occupied cell sprites is opaque; empty cells have no sprite.

macroMotif.hash: FNV-1a UTF-16 joined with |; use complete global occupancy; skip hash % 4 == 0

rolePalette.method: Exact authored native pixels; palette validated without conversion or spatial filtering.

nativeSourceProfile.method: Authoritative palette-validated native final art; source pixels copied exactly, with the legacy generated strip retained as history.

junctionOverlaySampling.roleSelection: declared architectural face provenance and its exact ink halo; never inferred from color
junctionOverlaySampling.whiteRoles: declared architectural faces only; body face colors and shades never select overlay pixels
excludedSourceRoles: all body brick faces and their facets
body mortar outside architectural face halos
junctionOverlaySampling.masks: variants[].junctionOverlayMasks[moduleKey]:16 north-first binary strings;1 means an opaque authored decoration/contour pixel was overlaid

decorativeSampling.sourceMethod: Registered authored decoration pixels and existing one-pixel ink halos over the shared globally phased body; native panel overrides are copied exactly without resampling.
decorativeSampling.registeredContourRole: first source-registered row/column in directional strips and outer patches; colors only, no alpha or geometry edits
decorativeSampling.outerCornerPolicy: authored 8px outer edge union; jade and unrelated mortar excluded from the overlay
decorativeSampling.innerCornerPolicy: complete 16x16 transparent authored decoration overlay; body remains visible outside decoration
